# Air France 爬虫

<!-- This README is generated by .github/scripts/docs.py from the scraper code, its results/ folder and .github/scrapers.json: change those and run the script instead of editing it. -->

[![tests](https://github.com/scrapfly/scrapfly-scrapers/raw/ci-status/badges/airfrance-scraper.svg)](https://github.com/scrapfly/scrapfly-scrapers/blob/ci-status/status/airfrance-scraper.md)

示例爬虫，用于收集来自 airfrance.fr 的往返航班报价，使用 Python 和 [Scrapfly](https://scrapfly.io/) 网页抓取 API 编写。属于 [scrapfly-scrapers](../docs/README.zh-CN.md) 项目。

- **指南:** [How to Scrape Air France Flights with Python (2026)](https://scrapfly.io/blog/posts/how-to-scrape-air-france-flights)
- **代码:** [`airfrance.py`](airfrance.py) · **示例运行:** [`run.py`](run.py) · **测试:** [`test.py`](test.py)
- **示例输出:** [Roundtrip](results/roundtrip.json)

## 抓取内容

- Air France 往返航班搜索结果
- 航班价格、航空公司、出发/到达时间、经停、时长、中转和 CO2 数据
- 机型、剩余座位和促销标记

## 函数

- `scrape_flights(origin, destination, departure_date, return_date, max_retries=3)` → `List[Flight]` （非异步）: Scrape flight offers from Air France search GraphQL XHR.

## 输出

这些函数返回普通的字典和列表。字段：

- **`Layover`**: `airport`, `duration_minutes?`
- **`Flight`**: `airline`, `flight_number`, `departure_time`, `departure_airport`, `arrival_time`, `arrival_airport`, `arrives_next_days`, `duration_minutes`, `stops`, `layovers`, `price`, `currency`, `cabin_class`, `seats_available?`, `is_promo`, `promo_title?`, `has_special_fare`, `seat_map_eligible`, `plane_model`, `co2_kg`, `airport_change_warning?`

标有 `?` 的字段可能为 `null`。

## 快速开始

需要 Python 3.10 及以上版本和 [Poetry](https://python-poetry.org/docs/#installation)。

```shell
git clone https://github.com/scrapfly/scrapfly-scrapers.git
cd scrapfly-scrapers/airfrance-scraper
export SCRAPFLY_KEY="YOUR SCRAPFLY KEY"   # 获取地址： https://scrapfly.io/dashboard
poetry install --no-root
poetry run python run.py                  # 示例抓取，结果保存在 ./results
poetry run pytest test.py                 # 运行该爬虫的测试
```

测试：`test_scrape_flights`；使用 `poetry run pytest test.py -k <test>` 运行单个测试。 `run.py` 和测试会抓取真实网站，因此会消耗 Scrapfly 积分。
